implemented: Detached whitelisted paper_research_exit_intent_v1 receipts freeze the decision quantity, reason, original clock, ladder plan and own raw quantity/cash/frozen costs/entry route/policy identity. They are estimated intent evidence, not signatures, fills or strategy acceptance.

Runner and entry-gate actual exit engines create these receipts before quote dispatch. Both secondary ticks and actual primary reverse-quote reuse pass the original pre-await request-start clock; none is synthesized from the later receipt or fill.

The actual estimated fill checks the original intent checksum/decision and exact current financial generation, then enforces decision_at <= quote_started_at <= original_quote_received_at <= filled_at. Missing, naive, conflicting or predecision clocks remain unresolved.
Estimated fills are applied copy-on-write. Rejected or malformed receipts, stale generations, invalid partial metadata and nonfinite cash accumulation leave the original arm unchanged.

Every accepted estimated research fill retains its original intent receipt and request-start clock. The terminal cash validator reconstructs each generation from the shared prefix and earlier fills, independently checks the public quote and chronology, and rejects legacy fills lacking this original proof.

Both runner cohort selection/manifest consumption and entry-gate cash/cohort consumers use that terminal validator. Existing files remain inspectable; no old receipt, decision, quote clock or learned manifest is rewritten or retrospectively certified.
Exact 0.1 SOL PAPER size, the uncapped runner ladder and prospective statistical selection thresholds remain unchanged. No active model or policy promotion was performed.
